detached_structure.evidence: A flat-roofed tan addition or deck-like section on the west side of the house appears attached; the red object at the south edge looks like a tarp or awning, not a clear separate building.

signals.notes: The house has a brown shingle roof with some weathering. Large trees on the north and east sides shade much of the lot, and landscaped rock beds and a sunroom or deck are on the west side, with a paved driveway to the east.
